name: kubernetes
title: Kubernetes
description: Creates a pod per machine in one namespace of the cluster Loomux runs in.

permissions.detail: create, get, list, watch and delete Pods, PersistentVolumeClaims and Secrets in one namespace; read Pod logs and Events there
reaches the Kubernetes API server; the cluster pulls the agent image from its registry

namespace.description: where machines are made; must exist, with the plugin's Role and the headless Service

storage_class.description: the StorageClass of a persistent machine's data volume

subdomain.description: the headless Service that names machines: lx-<id>.<subdomain>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local

agent_image.description: the image machines run; pin it by digest in production

kubeconfig.description: leave empty in-cluster (the mounted ServiceAccount is used)

sizes.description: machine sizes by name, each {cpu, memory, disk} in Kubernetes quantities; small/medium/large when empty

max_environments.description: how many machines this plugin makes at most

require_network_policy.description: refuse to make machines unless NetworkPolicy is enforced (true in production)
